name: 安全教育通知
description_zh: 为教师生成主题明确、风险点清楚、家校行动具体的安全教育通知，覆盖教育部七大类（交通/消防/卫生/防溺/反欺凌/网络/灾害）+ 节假日告家长书；严格引用官方口径（六不一会、四不要、三不一多等）。触发关键词：安全教育通知、防溺水通知、防火通知、交通安全通知、防欺凌通知、防诈骗通知、假期安全告家长书。
description_en: Generates safety-education notices with clear themes, explicit risk points, and concrete home-school actions for teachers, covering the Ministry of Education's seven categories (traffic / fire / hygiene / drowning prevention / anti-bullying / cyber / disaster) plus holiday letters to parents; strictly cites official wording (e.g., "six no's and one can", "four don'ts", "three no's and one more"). Trigger keywords: safety education notice, drowning-prevention notice, fire-prevention notice, traffic-safety notice, anti-bullying notice, anti-fraud notice, holiday safety letter to parents.
